response.overview: Real footage from strictly guarded locations around the world. Painting graffiti under the threat of losing health, freedom, or even life. The film takes you through the most modern cities in the world, where graffiti has been known for decades, but it will also be painted in developing countries where they have no idea what graffiti even is. Show Must Go On will show you the world. The world through the eyes of graffiti writers. Get ready for 100% real material from many global metropolises. USA, Canada, Vietnam, Philippines, Chile, Argentina, India, Myanmar, Georgia, UK, Malaysia, Indonesia, Africa, China, and more. The film is complemented by testimonies from individual protagonists who describe and explain specific situations they found themselves in. It is accompanied by a voiceover from journalist Zoe, who personally participated in most of the actions with the guys and is writing a book about it. As is customary for SMGO, the music for the film is pumped up like cabbage.
